node.statement: Collateral import bound: let P be a rank-3 exact signed idempotent (square real matrix with P^2 = P and all row sums equal to 1), let U = (u_0,u_1,u_2) be an actual-row chart whose rows p_{u_0}, p_{u_1}, p_{u_2} form a basis of the row space, define coordinates a_q(i) by p_i = sum_q a_q(i)p_{u_q}, beta_r(i) = P_{u_r i}, E_r(i) = max(sum_{q != r} max(-a_q(i),0) - (1 - a_r(i)), 0), and Phi_r(U) = sum_i max(beta_r(i),0)E_r(i); fix a pivot index s, a non-chart row j with c = a_s(j) > 0, a transverse index r != s, and let t be the remaining index, writing d_r = a_r(j) and d_t = a_t(j); on the pivot-removing chart V_j = U - u_s + j define new coordinates a_s^j(i) = a_s(i)/c and a_q^j(i) = a_q(i) - a_s(i)a_q(j)/c for q != s, E_r^j(i) = max(sum_{q != r} max(-a_q^j(i),0) - (1 - a_r^j(i)), 0), and Phi_r(V_j) = sum_i max(beta_r(i),0)E_r^j(i) (the transverse left-inverse row at r is unchanged by the move); define R_{r,j}(i) = (1/c - 1)*max(-a_s(i),0) + max(a_s(i)*d_t/c, 0) - a_s(i)*d_r/c and I_{r,j}(U) = sum_i max(beta_r(i),0)*max(R_{r,j}(i),0); then Phi_r(V_j) <= Phi_r(U) + I_{r,j}(U).
